switch_policy.criteria: Choose on predeclared dev metrics and total score+train cost; test must not choose A/B.
switch_policy.failure: If A scoring fails, stays incomplete, loses group coverage or exceeds scoring budget, run B explicitly. Never mix checkpoints or silently substitute data.
switch_policy.scope: Pilot controls, not validated hyperparameters or a novelty claim. Both plans keep fixed ICLDIST data.
